verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible serving endpoint, so grammar-constrained or JSON-structured output is a fair question for it. The evidence covers SSD expert offload, routing prediction, LoRA adapters and the /v1/chat/completions server, but never mentions grammars, JSON mode, JSON schema or any other output-constraint feature. An OpenAI-compatible endpoint by itself is not evidence of structured-output support.
